jobs.title: Freelance Cloud / Infrastructure Engineer (m/w/d) - DevOps | Platform | Security
jobs.description:
Für aktuelle und zukünftige Kundenprojekte suchen wir erfahrene freiberufliche Cloud Engineers, Infrastructure Engineers, DevOps-/Platform Engineers und Security-Spezialisten (m/w/d) aus unterschiedlichen technologischen Fachbereichen. 
 Wir suchen insbesondere Expertise in folgenden Bereichen: 
 
  Cloud Engineering  – AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud 
  DevOps & Platform Engineering  – Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Terraform, GitOps 
  Infrastructure Engineering  – Linux, Windows Server, Virtualisierung, Networking & Automation 
  Cybersecurity / Cloud Security / DevSecOps  – IAM, Application & Infrastructure Security 
  Cloud / Solution Architecture  – Cloud-Native, Distributed Systems & Infrastructure Architecture 
 
 Aufgaben 
  Mögliche Projekteinsätze:  
 Unsere Kundenprojekte reichen von Cloud-Migrationen und dem Aufbau moderner Cloud- und Infrastrukturplattformen über DevOps- und Platform-Engineering bis hin zu Automatisierungs-, Security- und Cloud-Architecture-Projekten. 
 Gesucht werden sowohl spezialisierte Cloud-, Infrastructure-, DevOps-, Platform- und Security-Engineers als auch Cloud Architects, Solution Architects und erfahrene technische Consultants. 
 Qualifikation 
  Must-Have-Qualifikationen:  
 
 Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in mindestens einem relevanten Cloud-, Infrastructure-, DevOps-, Platform- oder Security-Bereich 
 Erfahrung aus professionellen Cloud-, Infrastruktur-, DevOps-, Platform- oder Security-Projekten 
 Fundierte Expertise in mindestens einem der Bereiche Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, DevOps/Platform Engineering, Cloud Security/DevSecOps oder Cloud/Solution Architecture 
 Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise 
 Verfügbarkeit für freiberufliche Projekte in Deutschland bzw. im DACH-Raum 
 
  Nice-to-Have:  
 
 Erfahrung mit modernen Cloud-Plattformen wie AWS, Microsoft Azure oder Google Cloud 
 Kenntnisse in Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Terraform, GitOps oder vergleichbaren DevOps-/Platform-Technologien 
 Erfahrung mit Linux, Windows Server, Virtualisierung, Networking oder Infrastructure Automation 
 Erfahrung mit IAM, Cloud Security, Application Security, Infrastructure Security oder DevSecOps 
 Erfahrung mit Cloud-Native-Architekturen, verteilten Systemen oder Infrastructure Architecture 
 Erfahrung als Cloud Architect, Solution Architect, Tech Lead oder technischer Consultant 
 
  Erforderliche Sprachkenntnisse:  
 
 Deutsch – sehr gute bis verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse (C1 oder höher) 
 Englisch – gute bis sehr gute Kenntnisse (B2 oder höher) 
 
 Benefits 
 
 Attraktive und langfristige Projektperspektive 
 Flexible Remote-Arbeit je nach Projektanforderung 
 Direkte und transparente Kommunikation mit Nexgate 
 Schnelle Abstimmungs- und Entscheidungswege 
 Spannende Projekte bei namhaften Kunden 
 Möglichkeit auf Folgeprojekte und langfristige Zusammenarbeit 
 Faire und marktgerechte Vergütung 
 
  Klingt interessant?  
 Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit aktuellem Lebenslauf, möglichem Startdatum und deinem gewünschten Stundensatz. Nach Eingang deiner Bewerbung prüfen wir dein Profil und melden uns kurzfristig bei dir. 
 Nexgate GmbH 
 IT Projects | Cloud | Infrastructure | DevOps | Security | Freelance Specialists

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, SRE
jobs.description:
About Remote  
 Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote. 
 With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role. 
 We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform. 
 If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work! 
  What this job can offer you  
 Remote's SRE team exists so that our engineers can move quickly and our customers get a product that stays up. The team owns Kubernetes, AWS, PostgreSQL, CI infrastructure, our observability stack and the reliability practices that sits on top of all of it. 
 We are looking for a Team Leader to run that team. This is a 60% IC, 40% leadership role. You will own the career development of your reports, steer the teams focus using judgment against the company goals, and you will be the spokesperson for the team across engineering. You will also stay close enough to the technical work to set direction with credibility and to know when something is going wrong before it is escalated to you. 
 Reliability practice at Remote is maturing rather than mature. Our SLO framework is live on its first few teams and needs to reach the rest, there is real work to do on how we balance operational load against project delivery. If you want a team where the foundations are in place and the interesting problems are still open, this is that team. 
 What you bring 
 People leadership 
 
 You have led an SRE, infrastructure or platform engineering team, and you have owned your reports' growth, performance and career progression rather than just their sprints. 
 You coach both craft and the soft skills, you can point to people who grew because of it. 
 You handle underperformance directly and early, with clarity and empathy. 
 You have hired engineers, and you can tell the difference between a good interview and a good engineer. 
 You read team dynamics well and you resolve conflict rather than routing around it. 
 You have a natural talent fostering commitment to the goals of the company. 
 
 Technical depth 
 
 A hands-on background in site reliability, DevOps or cloud infrastructure engineering, deep enough that you can review your team's work, challenge a design and be taken seriously in an incident. 
 Kubernetes in production, including the operational reality of it rather than the happy path. 
 AWS at meaningful scale. 
 Hands on AI building, enablement, scaling AI infrastructure. 
 Solid o11y practices and principles, 
 Infrastructure as code with Terraform. 
 CI/CD systems such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Jenkins. 
 Docker and shell scripting. 
 You have run a reliability practice: incident response, on-call, SLOs and error budgets, and the discipline of turning incidents into changes that stick. 
 Understanding and history of working in regulated environments. 
 
 Ways of working 
 
 You prioritise exceptionally well when operational load and project work compete, and you protect your team's focus without dropping the operational commitment. 
 You write clearly. Remote is fully distributed and async, so most of your leadership will happen in writing. 
 You build relationships across teams. A lot of SRE's value comes from being the team others bring problems to early. 
 
 Nice to have 
 
 Working knowledge of a backend language, ideally Elixir, or otherwise Java, Clojure, Node.js, Python or similar.

jobs.description:
About the Team  
 Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets. 
 Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications. 
 Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges. 
 This open role is based in our tech hubs in London. 
 
  What You'll Do  
 As a  Senior Fullstack Engineer , you'll own complex product and technical problems across the merchant experience, from problem definition through design, implementation, production, and ongoing evolution. 
 You'll: 
 
 
 Design, build, and operate production systems across backend services and user-facing applications. 
 
 
 Lead technically complex initiatives across areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools. 
 
 
 Translate ambiguous business and merchant problems into scalable, pragmatic technical solutions. 
 
 
 Drive technical design and architecture decisions, considering scalability, reliability, maintainability, and long-term product needs. 
 
 
 Own systems and initiatives end-to-end, from early discovery and design through implementation, rollout, production operations, and iteration. 
 
 
 Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and engineers across teams to align on solutions and delivery. 
 
 
 Support and mentor other engineers through design discussions, code reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance. 
 
 
 Use AI-assisted development tools effectively to increase engineering velocity, while maintaining strong judgment around correctness, security, maintainability, and quality. 
 
 
 Work comfortably outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve problems end-to-end. 
 
 
  How We Work  
 
 
  Ownership:  Senior engineers take responsibility not only for implementation, but also for understanding the problem, shaping the solution, and ensuring it works successfully in production. 
 
 
  Collaboration:  We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations. Senior engineers are expected to help drive alignment when problems span multiple teams or areas. 
 
 
  Pragmatism:  We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity. 
 
 
  Flexibility:  We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries. 
 
 
  
  Our Tech Stack  
 Our backend services primarily use  Go and Kotlin , while our frontend applications use technologies such as  TypeScript and React . 
 We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure. 
 
  Our Humble Expectations  
 We're looking for engineers who have: 
 
 
 An AI-first mindset, with strong experience leveraging modern AI tools alongside solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack. 
 
 
 Strong experience designing, building, and operating production software at scale in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments. 
 
 
 Experience owning complex features, services, or technical initiatives from problem definition through production and ongoing operation. 
 
 
 Strong understanding of system design, APIs, databases, distributed systems, testing, observability, and production reliability.
